context: A boss and his manager discuss a real-estate column
purpose: Teach: 返還/減税/高騰/密度/共生/放射線/配偶/重複

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この記事、都心の土地が高騰してる話だな。
lines.en: This article's about land prices spiking in the city center.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact scan of the page. Slight pause after opening to locate the point. Measured, no performance. Eyes still on text.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。減税策の効果と相まって、密度の高い地域に投資が集まっています。
lines.en: Yes. Tax cuts are playing into it—investment's concentrating in the high-density zones.
lines.style: Steady, technical tone. Confident in the detail. Speaking clearly but not performing. Brief upward inflection on the cause-and-effect link.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 返還地区の話、配偶者控除の見直しとも絡んでくる。
lines.en: The redevelopment areas tie back to the spouse-tax-deduction changes too.
lines.style: Connecting pieces aloud. Slight forward lean in the voice. Thoughtful, not lecturing. The tone of someone who sees the pattern.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 共生をテーマにした自治体声明とも重複してます。
lines.en: And it overlaps with what the local governments are saying about coexistence.
lines.style: Adding the final point. Quiet certainty. Not rushing. The voice lands on 'coexistence' with a small weight to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 放射線関連のリスクは、別の章でしっかり評価しよう。
lines.en: We'll handle the radiation-risk piece separately—evaluate it properly there.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A decision being made aloud. Clear accent on 'properly.' Controlled, authoritative without coldness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Clean, immediate affirmation. No hesitation. Brief, respectful. The acknowledgment of someone listening and ready to move.
